emblem: A heart of ice held in six bells
motto: The heart remembers what the world forgets.
philosophy: Not an organization at all — the final chapter's foes are the remnants of two faiths and one monster, all converging on the same relic for different reasons: the cult to soothe it, Sigrun to end it, Krampus to control it, and the Herald to serve it.

midnight_ringer.name: The Midnight Ringer
midnight_ringer.intro: "It rings at midnight because that is when it listens hardest."
midnight_ringer.defeat: "I rang it to keep it asleep. Every night. For thirty years. And you're welcome."

winter_priest.name: Winter Priest Aurelia
winter_priest.intro: "The Echo Cult prays to the bells. We pray to what the bells belong to."
winter_priest.defeat: "You fight like someone who has already decided. That is how the seal was broken the first time."

hunter_sigrun.name: Hunter Sigrun
hunter_sigrun.intro: "Last chance to hand them over. My family didn't hide these bells for fun."
hunter_sigrun.defeat: "...No. I won't take them. But if the Chorus rings, you ring it — I won't carry that."

krampus_defector.name: Krampus Defector
krampus_defector.intro: "The descent is suicide. Convince me you're worth following."
krampus_defector.defeat: "Good enough. Keep your Pokémon close — the cold down there isn't weather."

echo_priest.name: Echo Priest Maltheus
echo_priest.intro: "You brought the bells to their altar. Whatever you intended — thank you."
echo_priest.defeat: "Now you understand. It was never about stopping the ringing. It is about choosing the hour."

director_krampus.name: Director Krampus
director_krampus.intro: "You rang my bell for me. Now let me show you what it was for."
director_krampus.defeat: "Magnificent. Now listen — because this time I am not your enemy."

frost_herald_true.name: The Frost Herald — Unbound
frost_herald_true.intro: "SIX OF SIX. WINTER OPENS ITS EYE."

boss_mechanic.name: The True Chorus
boss_mechanic.description: At half health the Herald joins with all six bells at once: its whole team gains Attack, Speed and critical-hit chance, while ice begins to close over the battlefield.
